# Copilot Instructions for Bb Repository

## Repository Overview
This is a simple static website repository originally forked from GitHub's Spoon-Knife example project. It serves as a demonstration of forking and contains basic HTML/CSS files along with some documentation.

## Repository Structure
- `index.html` - Main HTML page for the website
- `styles.css` - CSS stylesheet for the website
- `README.md` - Repository documentation explaining forking
- `family-court-dismissal-order.md` - Legal document example
- `test.md` - Simple test document

## Code Conventions

### HTML
- Use HTML5 doctype
- Include proper meta tags in the head section
- Use semantic HTML where appropriate
- Keep indentation consistent (2 spaces)
- Use lowercase for HTML tags and attributes

### CSS
- Use consistent indentation (2 spaces)
- Follow the existing style structure
- Keep selectors simple and maintainable
- Group related styles together

### Markdown
- Use proper markdown syntax
- Include clear headings for document structure
- Keep formatting consistent across documents

## Development Guidelines

### Making Changes
- This is a static website with no build process required
- Changes to HTML/CSS can be previewed by opening `index.html` in a browser
- No compilation or bundling is needed
- Test changes visually in a browser before committing

### Testing
- There is no automated test infrastructure for this repository
- Manual testing involves opening the HTML file in a web browser
- Verify that CSS styles are applied correctly
- Check that all links and references work properly

### Documentation
- Update README.md if making significant structural changes
- Keep documentation clear and concise
- Use proper markdown formatting

## Best Practices
- Make minimal, focused changes
- Maintain the simple nature of this example repository
- Keep files organized and easy to understand
- Preserve backward compatibility with existing structure
- Ensure HTML is valid and follows web standards
- Keep CSS maintainable and well-commented when necessary
